question: Quais são as 5 categorias de produtos com maior quantidade de itens físicos cadastrados?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    category_name_pt, 
    COUNT(product_id) AS total_products 
FROM marts.dim_products 
GROUP BY category_name_pt 
ORDER BY total_products DESC 
LIMIT 5;
